failure.exception: RuntimeError: parent route bucket has fewer than three non-parent masks
failure.root_cause: The r1 contract unnecessarily required every child to reside in its own parent route bucket. A rare real M73 train-only bucket contains fewer than three non-parent unique masks, so the requested fixed 32-parent plus 96-child extent is impossible under that stricter rule.

r2_supersession.allowed_change_only: Child candidates expand to all train-observed masks in the same operator/partition. Parent routing and the weighted objective population remain the selected parent's M73 route bucket.
still_forbidden: fewer or more than three children per parent
